Kun
Harness, from source

Kun combines Direct mode, Agent Graph, workflow runtime, extension APIs, permissions, and local recovery in a desktop agent. The lesson is that complex work needs a runtime contract for node state, cancellation, approvals, recovery, and plugins.

Thesis before source

CONTROL LOOP

BOUNDARY

BUILDING FIT

Agent Graph makes delegation visible

BORROW

  • Agent Graph makes delegation visible
  • Extension APIs use strict schemas for agents, tools, and permissions
  • Local-first recovery has an explicit state machine

WATCH

  • The desktop and runtime remain fairly coupled
  • More graph nodes increase state, cancellation, and error-propagation test cost
  • Local-first does not mean data never leaves the device

READING MODE

  • Pin the commit before tracing the call chain
  • Separate facts, inferences, and risks

   23  export function createBackgroundShellTool(options: BackgroundShellToolOptions = {}): LocalTool {
   24    return LocalToolHost.defineTool({
   25      name: 'background_shell',
   26      description:
   27        'Manage shell sessions started with bash background=true in the current thread. The bash tool assigns an 8-character session_id when starting a background command; use that id here. action="list" lists this thread\'s running sessions by default (set include_finished=true to also show completed/stopped/failed sessions). action="read" returns a non-blocking output snapshot. action="poll" waits up to yield_seconds for more output or exit. action="write" sends stdin via input. action="stop" terminates a running session.',
   28      inputSchema: {
   29        type: 'object',
   30        properties: {
   31          action: {
   32            type: 'string',
   33            enum: ['list', 'read', 'poll', 'write', 'stop']
   34          },
   35          session_id: {
   36            type: 'string',
   37            description: 'Required for read, poll, write, and stop. The 8-character id returned by bash when background=true.'
   38          },
   39          yield_seconds: { type: 'number' },
   40          include_finished: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
   41          // Kept only to tolerate old model transcripts. Listing is always
   42          // scoped to the invoking thread; false must never expose other
   43          // threads' commands, working directories, output, or log paths.
   44          thread_only: { type: 'boolean', default: true },
   45          input: { type: 'string' }
   46        },
   47        required: ['action'],
   48        additionalProperties: false
   49      },
   50      policy: 'auto',
   51      // `write` sends arbitrary stdin to a live shell, which can execute a
   52      // command even if the shell was created before a sandbox-policy change.
   53      // Keep the whole multipurpose tool in the command-execution class until
   54      // read-only observation actions are split into a separate tool.
   55      toolKind: 'command_execution',
   56      effects: {
   57        network: true,
   58        externalWrite: true,
   59        processExecution: true,
   60        guiAutomation: false
   61      },
   62      execute: async (args, context) =>
   63        withToolBoundary(async () => {
   64          const action = typeof args.action === 'string' ? args.action.trim() : ''
   65          if (action === 'list') {
   66            let sessions = options.listBackgroundSessions
   67              ? [...options.listBackgroundSessions(context.threadId)]
   68              : await listBashSessionRecords(context.threadId)
   69            if (args.include_finished !== true) {
   70              sessions = sessions.filter((session) => session.status === 'running')
   71            }
   72            return {
   73              output: {
   74                sessions: sessions.map((session) => ({
   75                  session_id: session.id,
   76                  command: session.command,
   77                  cwd: session.cwd,
   78                  shell: session.shell,
   79                  status: session.status,
   80                  started_at: session.startedAt,
   81                  ...(session.finishedAt ? { finished_at: session.finishedAt } : {}),
   82                  exit_code: session.exitCode,
   83                  output: session.output,

  248  export class FetchWebProvider implements WebProvider {
  249    readonly id = 'fetch'
  250    private readonly config: WebCapabilityConfig
  251    private readonly nowIso: () => string
  252    private readonly resolveHost: (hostname: string) => Promise<ResolvedAddress[]>
  253    private readonly request: (request: FetchWebTransportRequest) => Promise<FetchWebTransportResponse>
  254
  255    constructor(config: WebCapabilityConfig, options: FetchWebProviderOptions = {}) {
  256      this.config = config
  257      this.nowIso = options.nowIso ?? (() => new Date().toISOString())
  258      this.resolveHost = options.resolveHost ?? resolveHostAddresses
  259      this.request = options.request ?? requestWithPinnedLookup
  260    }
  261
  262    async fetch(request: {
  263      url: string
  264      maxBytes: number
  265      timeoutMs: number
  266      signal: AbortSignal
  267    }): Promise<WebFetchResult> {
  268      const controller = new AbortController()
  269      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), request.timeoutMs)
  270      const onAbort = () => controller.abort()
  271      request.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
  272      try {
  273        let currentUrl = new URL(request.url)
  274        let redirectCount = 0
  275        let response: FetchWebTransportResponse | undefined
  276
  277        while (true) {
  278          const policy = validateUrlPolicy(currentUrl.href, this.config)
  279          if (!policy.ok) throw new WebFetchPolicyError(policy.reason)
  280          const resolved = await awaitWithAbort(this.resolveDestination(policy.url), controller.signal)
  281          response = await this.request({
  282            url: policy.url,
  283            lookup: pinnedLookup(policy.url.hostname, resolved),
  284            signal: controller.signal
  285          })
  286
  287          if (!isRedirectStatus(response.status)) break
  288          const location = response.location
  289          response.cancel()
  290          if (!location) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} redirect is missing a Location header`)
  291          if (redirectCount >= MAX_WEB_REDIRECTS) throw new Error(`redirect limit (${MAX_WEB_REDIRECTS}) exceeded`)
  292          try {
  293            currentUrl = new URL(location, policy.url)
  294          } catch {
  295            throw new WebFetchPolicyError('redirect Location must be a valid absolute or relative HTTP URL')
  296          }
  297          redirectCount += 1
  298        }
  299
  300        if (!response) throw new Error('web response is unavailable')
  301        if (response.status < 200 || response.status >= 300) {
  302          response.cancel()
  303          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`)
  304        }
  305
  306        // Oversized pages truncate at maxBytes via the streaming read below.
  307        // Hard-failing on the declared content-length made most real pages
  308        // unfetchable whenever the model passed a small byte budget.

   32      name: 'ls',

   67            names: entries.map((entry) => (entry.kind === 'directory' ? `${entry.name}/` : entry.name)),
   68            truncated: entries.length >= limit,

  179  export function mcpSearchDiagnostic(input: {
  180    config: McpSearchConfig
  181    active: boolean
  182    indexedToolCount: number
  183    advertisedToolCount: number
  184    state: McpSearchCatalogState
  185  }): McpSearchRuntimeDiagnostic {

  194      minScore: input.config.minScore,
  195      ...(input.state.lastRefreshedAt ? { lastRefreshedAt: input.state.lastRefreshedAt } : {}),
  196      ...(input.state.lastError ? { lastError: input.state.lastError } : {}),
  197      ...(input.state.catalogFingerprint ? { catalogFingerprint: input.state.catalogFingerprint } : {}),
  198      ...(input.state.catalogDrift !== undefined ? { catalogDrift: input.state.catalogDrift } : {})
  199    }

  201
  202  export function tokenizeMcpSearchText(text = ''): string[] {
  203    const source = normalizeLower(text)
  204    const tokens: string[] = []
  205
  206    const latinTerms = source.match(/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{1,}/g) ?? []
  207    for (const term of latinTerms) {
  208      for (const part of term.split(/[_-]+/)) {
  209        if (tokenAllowed(part)) tokens.push(part)
  210      }
  211      if (tokenAllowed(term)) tokens.push(term)
  212    }
  213
  214    const hanSegments = source.match(/\p{Script=Han}+/gu) ?? []
  215    for (const segment of hanSegments) {
  216      const chars = [...segment].slice(0, 80)
  217      if (chars.length === 1) {
  218        tokens.push(chars[0])
  219        continue
  220      }
  221      for (let size = 2; size <= Math.min(4, chars.length); size += 1) {
  222        for (let index = 0; index <= chars.length - size; index += 1) {
  223          tokens.push(chars.slice(index, index + size).join(''))
  224        }
  225      }
  226    }
  227
  228    return tokens
  229  }

  673  export class MiniMaxVideoClient implements VideoGenClient {
  674    readonly id = 'minimax-video'
  675    private readonly rootUrl: string
  676
  677    constructor(
  678      baseUrl: string,
  679      private readonly apiKey: string
  680    ) {
  681      this.rootUrl = minimaxRootUrl(baseUrl)
  682    }
  683
  684    async generate(request: VideoGenRequest): Promise<GeneratedMedia> {
  685      const signal = withTimeout(request.signal, request.timeoutMs)
  686      const createPayload = await requestJson<MiniMaxVideoCreatePayload>(`${this.rootUrl}/v1/video_generation`, {
  687        method: 'POST',
  688        headers: this.headers(),
  689        body: JSON.stringify({
  690          model: request.model,
  691          prompt: request.prompt,
  692          duration: request.duration,
  693          resolution: request.resolution,
  694          ...(request.firstFrameImage
  695            ? { first_frame_image: dataUri(request.firstFrameImage.mimeType, request.firstFrameImage.data) }
  696            : {}),
  697          ...(request.lastFrameImage
  698            ? { last_frame_image: dataUri(request.lastFrameImage.mimeType, request.lastFrameImage.data) }
  699            : {})
  700        }),
  701        signal
  702      }, request)
  703      assertMiniMaxOk(createPayload.base_resp, 'MiniMax video provider')
  704      const taskId = createPayload.task_id
  705      if (!taskId) throw new Error('MiniMax video provider returned no task_id')
  706      await request.onUpdate?.({
  707        output: { status: 'submitted', taskId, provider: this.id }
  708      })
  709
  710      const deadline = Date.now() + request.timeoutMs
  711      let lastStatus = 'submitted'
  712      while (Date.now() < deadline) {
  713        await delay(request.pollIntervalMs, signal)
  714        const queryUrl = new URL(`${this.rootUrl}/v1/query/video_generation`)
  715        queryUrl.searchParams.set('task_id', taskId)
  716        const queryPayload = await requestJson<MiniMaxVideoQueryPayload>(queryUrl.toString(), {
  717          method: 'GET',
  718          headers: this.headers(),
  719          signal
  720        }, request)
  721        assertMiniMaxOk(queryPayload.base_resp, 'MiniMax video provider')
  722        lastStatus = queryPayload.status || lastStatus
  723        await request.onUpdate?.({
  724          output: { status: lastStatus, taskId, provider: this.id }
  725        })
  726        if (isFailureStatus(lastStatus)) {
  727          throw new Error(`MiniMax video generation failed with status ${lastStatus}`)
  728        }
  729        if (!isSuccessStatus(lastStatus)) continue
  730        const fileId = queryPayload.file_id
  731        if (!fileId) throw new Error('MiniMax video provider finished without file_id')
  732        const downloadUrl = await this.retrieveDownloadUrl(fileId, request)
  733        const response = await requestResponse(downloadUrl, { method: 'GET', signal }, request)

  140  export function buildSpeechGenToolProviders(
  141    config: KunCapabilitiesConfig['speechGen'] | undefined,
  142    options: MediaGenToolProviderOptions = {}
  143  ): SpeechGenToolProviderBuildResult {
  144    if (!config?.enabled) return { providers: [], diagnostics: [], available: false }

   13  export function createReadArtifactTool(): LocalTool {
   14    return LocalToolHost.defineTool({
   15      name: 'read_artifact',
   16      description:
   17        'Read a stored artifact (large tool output) by id. Optionally fetch only a slice: ' +
   18        'startLine/endLine for a 1-indexed inclusive line range, or offset/length for a UTF-8 byte range. ' +
   19        'Use the artifact id returned by a previous tool result (e.g. stdoutArtifactId).',
   20      inputSchema: {
   21        type: 'object',
   22        properties: {
   23          artifactId: { type: 'string' },
   24          offset: { type: 'number' },
   25          length: { type: 'number' },
   26          startLine: { type: 'number' },
   27          endLine: { type: 'number' }
   28        },
   29        required: ['artifactId'],
   30        additionalProperties: false
   31      },
   32      policy: 'auto',
   33      execute: async (args, context) => {
   34        if (!context.artifactStore) {
   35          return { output: { error: 'artifact store is not available in this runtime' }, isError: true }
   36        }
   37        const artifactId = typeof args.artifactId === 'string' ? args.artifactId.trim() : ''
   38        if (!artifactId) return { output: { error: 'artifactId is required' }, isError: true }
   39        if (
   40          context.allowedArtifactIds &&
   41          !context.allowedArtifactIds.includes(artifactId)
   42        ) {
   43          return {
   44            output: { error: `artifact is outside the delegated child capability set: ${artifactId}` },
   45            isError: true
   46          }
   47        }
   48        const meta = await context.artifactStore.stat(artifactId)
   49        if (!meta) return { output: { error: `artifact not found: ${artifactId}` }, isError: true }
   50        const range = {
   51          ...(typeof args.offset === 'number' ? { offset: args.offset } : {}),
   52          ...(typeof args.length === 'number' ? { length: args.length } : {}),
   53          ...(typeof args.startLine === 'number' ? { startLine: args.startLine } : {}),
   54          ...(typeof args.endLine === 'number' ? { endLine: args.endLine } : {})
   55        }
   56        // Always read through the bounded reader: a request with no range, or a
   57        // range larger than the cap, is clamped to <=1 MiB / <=2000 lines and a
   58        // cursor is returned so the model pages rather than pulling a huge result
   59        // into context.
   60        const bounded = await readArtifactBounded(context.artifactStore, artifactId, meta, range)
   61        if (bounded === null) return { output: { error: `artifact content not found: ${artifactId}` }, isError: true }
   62        return {
   63          output: {
   64            artifactId,
   65            byteSize: meta.byteSize,
   66            lineCount: meta.lineCount,
   67            ...(meta.source ? { source: meta.source } : {}),
   68            ...(meta.origin ? { origin: meta.origin } : {}),
   69            range: bounded.range,
   70            truncated: bounded.truncated,
   71            ...(bounded.nextOffset !== undefined ? { nextOffset: bounded.nextOffset } : {}),
   72            ...(bounded.nextStartLine !== undefined ? { nextStartLine: bounded.nextStartLine } : {}),
   73            content: bounded.content
   74          }

   53      description:
   54        'Plan and drive a dependency-aware task graph for this thread. actions: ' +
   55        '"add" (id,title,dependsOn?,priority?), "list", "next" (runnable now), ' +
   56        '"start" (id), "complete" (id), "fail" (id,error), and "pause"/"resume"/"cancel" (id). ' +
   57        'Retry and concurrency policy are configured by the host. Tasks become runnable only when their dependencies succeed.',
   58      inputSchema: {
   59        type: 'object',
   60        properties: {
   61          action: { type: 'string', enum: ['add', 'list', 'next', 'start', 'complete', 'fail', 'pause', 'resume', 'cancel'] },
   62          id: { type: 'string' },
   63          title: { type: 'string' },
   64          dependsOn: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
   65          priority: { type: 'number' },
   66          error: { type: 'string' }
   67        },
   68        required: ['action'],
   69        additionalProperties: false
   70      },
   71      policy: 'auto',
   72      execute: async (args, context) => {
   73        const graph = await graphFor(context.threadId)
   74        const action = typeof args.action === 'string' ? args.action : ''
   75        const id = typeof args.id === 'string' ? args.id.trim() : ''
   76        try {
   77          switch (action) {
   78            case 'add': {
   79              if (!id || typeof args.title !== 'string' || !args.title.trim()) {
   80                return { output: { error: 'id and title are required for add' }, isError: true }
   81              }
   82              graph.add({
   83                id,
   84                title: args.title.trim(),
   85                ...(Array.isArray(args.dependsOn) ? { dependsOn: args.dependsOn.filter((d): d is string => typeof d === 'string') } : {}),
   86                ...(typeof args.priority === 'number' ? { priority: args.priority } : {}),
   87                maxAttempts
   88              })
   89              await save(context.threadId, graph)
   90              return { output: { action, added: id, ...snapshot(graph) } }
   91            }
   92            case 'list':
   93            case 'next':
   94              return { output: { action, ...snapshot(graph) } }
   95            case 'start':
   96              graph.markRunning(id)
   97              await save(context.threadId, graph)
   98              return { output: { action, id, ...snapshot(graph) } }
   99            case 'complete':
  100              graph.markSucceeded(id)
  101              await save(context.threadId, graph)
  102              return { output: { action, id, ...snapshot(graph) } }
  103            case 'fail': {
  104              const outcome = graph.markFailed(id, typeof args.error === 'string' ? args.error : 'unspecified failure')
  105              await save(context.threadId, graph)
  106              return { output: { action, id, retried: outcome.retried, ...snapshot(graph) } }
  107            }
  108            case 'pause': graph.pause(id); await save(context.threadId, graph); return { output: { action, id, ...snapshot(graph) } }
  109            case 'resume': graph.resume(id); await save(context.threadId, graph); return { output: { action, id, ...snapshot(graph) } }
  110            case 'cancel': graph.cancel(id); await save(context.threadId, graph); return { output: { action, id, ...snapshot(graph) } }

  162  /** Merge builtin profiles into a subagents config (user profiles take precedence). */
  163  export function mergeBuiltinSubagentProfiles(
  164    config: SubagentsCapabilityConfig
  165  ): SubagentsCapabilityConfig {
  166    // Per-id DEEP merge (builtin base < user override), NOT a shallow replace.
  167    // The GUI persists a builtin override carrying only the edited fields (a
  168    // model pick, a reasoning level, or a deny-list) and drops the localized
  169    // name; a shallow `{ ...builtins, ...config.profiles }` would let that thin
  170    // override clobber the builtin's promptPreamble/description/systemPrompt.
  171    // Merging per id keeps those as fallbacks while the user's fields still win.
  172    const profiles: Record<string, SubagentProfileConfig> = Object.fromEntries(
  173      Object.entries(config.profiles).map(([id, profile]) => [id, canonicalSurfaceProfile(profile)])
  174    )
  175    for (const [id, builtin] of Object.entries(BUILTIN_SUBAGENT_PROFILES)) {
  176      const override = config.profiles[id]
  177      profiles[id] = canonicalSurfaceProfile(override ? { ...builtin, ...override } : builtin)
  178    }
  179    profiles.general = { ...profiles.general, surfaces: ['shared'] }
  180    // Default a child with no explicit `profile` to the built-in `general`
  181    // profile (always present after the merge). Without this, an omitted profile
  182    // resolves to `undefined`, so the run carries no profile id — the GUI then
  183    // can't label the subagent and falls back to a generic name.
  184    const defaultProfile = config.defaultProfile ?? 'general'
  185    return { ...config, profiles, defaultProfile }
  186  }

docs/workflow-loop.md:1–25PINNED ↗
    1  # Loop 循环节点 —— 让 agent 自己转圈，而不是你按回车
    2
    3  > 适用于「创建loop / Workflows」里的 **Loop（循环）节点**。
    4  > 实现在 [`src/main/workflow-runtime.ts`](../src/main/workflow-runtime.ts)（`executeNode` 的 `case 'loop'`），配置归一化在 [`src/shared/app-settings-workflow.ts`](../src/shared/app-settings-workflow.ts)，测试在 [`src/main/workflow-runtime.nodes.test.ts`](../src/main/workflow-runtime.nodes.test.ts)。
    5
    6  ---
    7
    8  ## 先理清三个容易混的名字
    9
   10  | 名字 | 是什么 |
   11  | --- | --- |
   12  | **创建loop（Create Loop）** | **一整个工作流**本身。产品里一个工作流就叫一个「创建loop」。 |
   13  | **Loop（循环）节点** | 工作流里的**一个节点**，把另一个「创建loop」当成**循环体反复执行**。本文讲的就是它。 |
   14  | **运行创建loop（子工作流）节点** | 把另一个「创建loop」**只跑一次**（不循环、不反馈）。 |
   15
   16  一句话区分：**子工作流 = 跑一次；Loop 节点 = 反复跑 + 把结果折回去（或对一组元素各跑一遍）。**
   17
   18  ---
   19
   20  ## 核心思想：循环驱动 agent，而不是人驱动 agent
   21
   22  传统的对话式 agent 是这样的：
   23
   24  ```
   25  你打字 → agent 回答 → 你读 → 你决定下一步 → 你再打字 → …
   26  ```
   27
   28  注意循环在哪儿：**循环在「你」身上**。每一轮都靠你坐在那儿、读完结果、按回车把它推到下一轮。agent 只是被你一次次手动喂的那只手。
   29
   30  Loop 节点把这件事**反过来**。你不再一轮一轮地催，而是**一次性声明三件事**：
   31
   32  1. **每轮要干的活（目标）** —— 循环体，本身是一个完整的「创建loop」，里面可以有 AI 节点、条件判断、HTTP、代码等任意节点。
   33  2. **每轮的输出怎么喂回下一轮** —— 上一轮 output 自动变成下一轮 input。
   34  3. **什么时候算完** —— 一个停止条件，外加 `maxIterations` 作为兜底硬顶。
   35
   36  声明完，循环就**自己转**：agent 在「干活 → 看结果 → 再干活」的圈里自走，不需要你在每一轮按回车。
   37
   38  > **一句话：你设目标 + 每轮的活 + 何时算完，剩下交给循环。**
   39
   40  这正是把你本来要**手动重复输入**的那些催促——“再试一次”“现在把 lint 错误修了”“一直跑到测试过”——**一次写成规则，让它无人值守地跑**。这也是整个功能为什么叫「创建loop」：核心赌注就是，agent 工作的未来形态是**声明一个循环（目标 + 循环体 + 停止条件）**，而不是守着聊天框一轮一轮地敲。
   41
   42  ### 为什么"迭代"才是 agent 真正的形状
   43
   44  - 单次 prompt → 单次回答，是**问答**。
   45  - 把输出折回输入、直到收敛，是**迭代**。
   46
   47  agent 真正干活时几乎都是迭代：草稿 → 自审 → 改稿；跑 → 报错 → 修；调工具 → 不满足 → 再调。Loop 节点把"迭代"变成画布上的**一等公民**——而且因为循环体是一个完整工作流，**"一轮"可以任意复杂**，不是只重复一个节点。
   48
   49  ---
   50
   51  ## 两种循环形态
   52
   53  Loop 节点有两个 `mode`，对应两种完全不同的迭代意图。
   54
   55  ### 1. 条件循环（Condition / loop-agent）—— 反复打磨直到达标
   56
   57  意图：**“一直干到目标满足”**。每一轮把循环体的输出当作下一轮的输入，满足停止条件就停；否则一直到 `maxIterations` 兜底停。
   58
   59  - **停止条件**：`leftExpr` / `operator` / `rightValue` / `caseSensitive`，复用 condition 节点那一套判断。默认是 `json.done` `equals` `true`。
   60  - **反馈**：上一轮 `output` → 下一轮 `payload`，所以循环体能在上一轮基础上继续推进。
   61  - **输出**：循环体最后一轮的 json，外加两个元字段——
   62    - `_iterations`：实际跑了几轮；
   63    - `_done`：`true` = 停止条件达成；`false` = 没达成、是被 `maxIterations` 兜底截停的。
   64  - **节点 message**：`looped N (done)` 或 `looped N (max)`。
   65
   66  这就是 **loop-agent**：像一个人不断 refine 直到自己满意，只是把"满意"交给停止条件来判定，把"再来一轮"交给循环来推动。
   67
   68  > 例：**研究循环**。循环体 = 一个 AI 节点（读资料、补充结论、自评是否够了），停止条件 = `json.enough == true`，`maxIterations = 6`。agent 自己读、自己判断够不够、不够就再来一轮，够了或到 6 轮就停。
   69
   70  ### 2. 遍历数组（For each）—— 同样的活，对每个元素干一遍
   71
   72  意图：**“对列表里每个元素，各跑一遍循环体”**。这是**批处理**，不是打磨——元素之间互不反馈。
   73
   74  - **数组来源**：`arraySource` 表达式；留空则用上游 `payload.json`（要求是数组）。
   75  - **执行方式**：`sequential`（一个接一个）/ `parallel`（同时跑，`concurrency` 并发 1–8）。**并行也保证输出顺序与输入一致。**
   76  - **出错策略**：`continueOnError`
   77    - 打开：某个元素出错就把它记成 `{ error: "..." }`、跳过、继续跑其余元素（**韧性**）；
   78    - 关闭（默认）：一旦有元素出错，立即中止、整个 Loop 节点报错（**fail-fast**）。
   79  - **输出**：每个元素结果组成的数组。**节点 message**：`foreach 成功数/总数`（并行时带 `(parallel)`）。
   80
   81  > 例：对 50 个文件**各跑一遍** “AI 总结”，`parallel`、`concurrency = 4`、`continueOnError = on`，最后拿到 50 条结果（出错的那条是 `{error}`）。
   82
   83  ---
   84
   85  ## 循环体里能用的变量：`$loop`
   86
   87  循环体里**任意节点**都能用 `{{ }}` 插值引用当前这一轮的上下文：
   88
   89  | 变量 | 含义 |
   90  | --- | --- |
   91  | `{{$loop.index}}` | 当前轮 / 当前元素的下标（从 0 开始） |
   92  | `{{$loop.item}}` | 当前元素（foreach）；条件循环里是**上一轮输出的 json** |
   93  | `{{$loop.total}}` | 总数（foreach = 数组长度；条件循环 = `maxIterations`） |
   94
   95  ---
   96

    4    'commands.register',
    5    'ui.views',
    6    'ui.actions',

    8    'webview',
    9    'webview.external',
   10    'hostDom',
   11    'agent.run',
   12    'agent.threads.readOwn',

   25
   26  export const StaticPermissionSchema = z.enum(STATIC_PERMISSIONS)
   27  export type StaticPermission = z.infer<typeof StaticPermissionSchema>
   28
   29  export const PROVIDER_PERMISSION_PATTERN =
   30    /^accounts\.(?:use|manage|secrets\.read):(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.)?[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/
   31  export const NETWORK_PERMISSION_PATTERN =
   32    /^network:(?:\*\.)?(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)*[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/
   33
   34  export const ScopedPermissionSchema = z.union([
   35    z.string().regex(PROVIDER_PERMISSION_PATTERN),
   36    z.string().regex(NETWORK_PERMISSION_PATTERN)
   37  ])
   38  export type ScopedPermission = `accounts.${'use' | 'manage' | 'secrets.read'}:${string}` | `network:${string}`
   39
   40  export const PermissionSchema = z.union([StaticPermissionSchema, ScopedPermissionSchema])
   41  export type Permission = StaticPermission | ScopedPermission
   42
   43  export function permissionMatches(granted: string, requested: string): boolean {
   44    if (granted === requested) return true
   45    if (!granted.startsWith('network:') || !requested.startsWith('network:')) return false
   46    const grantHost = granted.slice('network:'.length)
   47    const requestedHost = requested.slice('network:'.length)
   48    return grantHost.startsWith('*.') && requestedHost.endsWith(grantHost.slice(1))
   49  }
   50
   51  export function hasPermission(grants: readonly string[], requested: string): boolean {
   52    return grants.some((grant) => permissionMatches(grant, requested))
   53  }

SOURCE FACT

    1  import { z } from 'zod'
    2
    3  export const STATIC_PERMISSIONS = [
    4    'commands.register',
    5    'ui.views',
    6    'ui.actions',
    7    'ui.notifications',
    8    'webview',
    9    'webview.external',
   10    'hostDom',
   11    'agent.run',
   12    'agent.threads.readOwn',
   13    'tools.register',
   14    'providers.register',
   15    'accounts.read',
   16    'storage.global',
   17    'storage.workspace',
   18    'workspace.read',
   19    'workspace.write',
   20    'media.read',
   21    'media.process',
   22    'media.export',
   23    'jobs.manage'
   24  ] as const
   25
   26  export const StaticPermissionSchema = z.enum(STATIC_PERMISSIONS)
   27  export type StaticPermission = z.infer<typeof StaticPermissionSchema>
   28
   29  export const PROVIDER_PERMISSION_PATTERN =
   30    /^accounts\.(?:use|manage|secrets\.read):(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*\.)?[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/
   31  export const NETWORK_PERMISSION_PATTERN =
   32    /^network:(?:\*\.)?(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)*[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/
   33
   34  export const ScopedPermissionSchema = z.union([
   35    z.string().regex(PROVIDER_PERMISSION_PATTERN),
   36    z.string().regex(NETWORK_PERMISSION_PATTERN)
   37  ])
   38  export type ScopedPermission = `accounts.${'use' | 'manage' | 'secrets.read'}:${string}` | `network:${string}`
   39
   40  export const PermissionSchema = z.union([StaticPermissionSchema, ScopedPermissionSchema])
   41  export type Permission = StaticPermission | ScopedPermission
   42
   43  export function permissionMatches(granted: string, requested: string): boolean {
   44    if (granted === requested) return true
   45    if (!granted.startsWith('network:') || !requested.startsWith('network:')) return false
   46    const grantHost = granted.slice('network:'.length)
   47    const requestedHost = requested.slice('network:'.length)
   48    return grantHost.startsWith('*.') && requestedHost.endsWith(grantHost.slice(1))
   49  }
   50
   51  export function hasPermission(grants: readonly string[], requested: string): boolean {
   52    return grants.some((grant) => permissionMatches(grant, requested))
   53  }
   54

    6    WorkflowRuntimeStatus

    9  type PendingApproval = {
   10    entry: WorkflowPendingApprovalV1
   11    resolve: (decision: WorkflowApprovalDecision) => void
   12  }
   13
   14  /** Single writer for run lifecycle, cancellation, approvals, and live projection. */
   15  export class WorkflowRunCoordinator {
   16    private readonly runningWorkflowIds = new Set<string>()
   17    private readonly cancelRequested = new Set<string>()
   18    private readonly pendingApprovals = new Map<string, PendingApproval>()
   19    private readonly liveNodeStatus = new Map<string, Map<string, WorkflowNodeRunStatus>>()
   20    private readonly liveNodeResults = new Map<string, Map<string, WorkflowNodeRunResultV1>>()
   21    private readonly abortControllers = new Map<string, AbortController>()
   22    private readonly cleanupTimers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()
   23
   24    isRunning(workflowId: string): boolean {
   25      return this.runningWorkflowIds.has(workflowId)
   26    }
   27
   28    begin(workflowId: string, nodeIds: readonly string[]): boolean {
   29      if (this.runningWorkflowIds.has(workflowId)) return false
   30      this.runningWorkflowIds.add(workflowId)
   31      this.cancelRequested.delete(workflowId)
   32      this.abortControllers.set(workflowId, new AbortController())
   33      this.liveNodeStatus.set(workflowId, new Map(nodeIds.map((nodeId) => [nodeId, 'pending'])))
   34      this.liveNodeResults.set(workflowId, new Map())
   35      return true
   36    }
   37
   38    finish(workflowId: string, runId: string, lingerMs: number): void {
   39      this.runningWorkflowIds.delete(workflowId)
   40      this.cancelRequested.delete(workflowId)
   41      this.abortControllers.delete(workflowId)
   42      for (const [token, pending] of this.pendingApprovals) {
   43        if (pending.entry.runId === runId) this.pendingApprovals.delete(token)
   44      }
   45      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   46        this.cleanupTimers.delete(timer)
   47        this.liveNodeStatus.delete(workflowId)
   48        this.liveNodeResults.delete(workflowId)
   49      }, lingerMs)
   50      timer.unref?.()
   51      this.cleanupTimers.add(timer)
   52    }
   53
   54    beginSingleNode(workflowId: string, nodeId: string): Map<string, WorkflowNodeRunStatus> {
   55      const live = new Map<string, WorkflowNodeRunStatus>([[nodeId, 'running']])
   56      this.liveNodeStatus.set(workflowId, live)
   57      return live
   58    }
   59
   60    finishSingleNode(workflowId: string, lingerMs: number): void {
   61      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   62        this.cleanupTimers.delete(timer)
   63        this.liveNodeStatus.delete(workflowId)
   64      }, lingerMs)
   65      timer.unref?.()
   66      this.cleanupTimers.add(timer)
   67    }
   68
   69    requestCancel(workflowId: string): boolean {
   70      if (!this.runningWorkflowIds.has(workflowId)) return false
   71      this.cancelRequested.add(workflowId)
   72      this.abortControllers.get(workflowId)?.abort()
   73      for (const pending of this.pendingApprovals.values()) {
   74        if (pending.entry.workflowId === workflowId) pending.resolve('rejected')
   75      }
   76      return true
   77    }
   78
   79    isCanceled(workflowId: string | undefined): boolean {
   80      return workflowId ? this.cancelRequested.has(workflowId) : false
   81    }
   82
   83    signal(workflowId: string): AbortSignal | undefined {
   84      return this.abortControllers.get(workflowId)?.signal
   85    }
   86
   87    cancelAll(): void {
   88      for (const workflowId of [...this.runningWorkflowIds]) this.requestCancel(workflowId)
   89      for (const pending of [...this.pendingApprovals.values()]) pending.resolve('rejected')
   90      for (const timer of this.cleanupTimers) clearTimeout(timer)
   91      this.cleanupTimers.clear()
   92    }
   93
   94    setLive(workflowId: string, nodeId: string, status: WorkflowNodeRunStatus): void {
   95      const map = this.liveNodeStatus.get(workflowId) ?? new Map<string, WorkflowNodeRunStatus>()
   96      map.set(nodeId, status)
   97      this.liveNodeStatus.set(workflowId, map)

L1factrecovery

01 · Recovery, tests & trade-offs

SOURCE FACT

Recovery inventory, candidates, repair states, and coordinator cancellation cover interrupted work rather than merely restarting the UI.

PLAIN LANGUAGE

Treat the project as a workshop: find the entrypoint, workbench, toolbox, and delivery desk before memorizing APIs.

IMPLICATION

Place this implementation back into the task chain and inspect input, state, effects, receipts, and recovery exits.

LINE-BY-LINE READING
  1. 6–19
    Inputs, configuration, and state

    Identify who owns the input, which configuration is read, and which state is created.

  2. 20–35
    Branches, effects, and receipts

    Trace conditions, external calls, event writes, and failure exits instead of reading only names.

  3. after
    Return to the caller

    Follow the caller and the next event to see how this code's result is consumed.
